source_summary: Ink-and-wash Chinese landscape with misty cliffs, overhanging branches, a right-side pine and hillside, two laden pack animals, a walking traveler, and sparse foreground bank/rocks. Seals and calligraphy are excluded.

motifs.name: left_misty_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the large mist-softened cliff mass on the left, including its sloping ridge, pale wash face, darker vertical ink streaks, and the atmospheric fading into the surrounding blank space.
must_preserve: misty lost edges at top and lower right

motifs.name: upper_overhanging_branches
motifs.description: Isolate the sparse dark branches descending from the top center, with fine twig clusters and drooping leaf marks, excluding seals and unrelated landscape below.

motifs.name: distant_mist_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the faint central background hills and valley washes behind the traveler, including pale mountain contours, blurred tree-like marks, and soft mist openings.

motifs.name: right_pine_hillside
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side sloping hillside with prominent pine-like branches and dark needle clusters, including the angular limbs crossing the upper-right slope while avoiding the traveler figure.
must_preserve: dark ink knots and leaf dots
dry-brush contour lines on the slope

motifs.name: left_pack_donkey
motifs.description: Isolate the left laden pack animal, including its head, ears, legs, dark back wash, and woven basket load with rounded contents.
must_preserve: thin ink outline of donkey head and legs
rounded load shapes at basket top
small harness lines and hanging strap details

motifs.name: right_pack_donkey
motifs.description: Isolate the right laden pack animal, including its lowered head, thin legs, tail, back wash, and tall cylindrical basket packed with upright sticks or reeds.
must_preserve: fine contour lines around muzzle and ears
soft gray wash over the animal body
delicate leg joints and hoof strokes

motifs.name: walking_traveler_with_pole
motifs.description: Isolate the walking traveler at right-center, including hat, robe folds, lifted legs, long shoulder pole or staff, and dangling bundle behind him.
must_preserve: fold lines at sleeves and trousers

motifs.name: foreground_bank_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the low foreground bank across the bottom, with sparse reeds, small rocks, dark horizontal wash ridges, and the rocky mound near the lower right, excluding seals and inscriptions.
must_preserve: rounded rock outlines and gray wash on the lower-right mound

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
